text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 4, 2025) for 332 Chisholm Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 4, 2025) for 332 Chisholm Avenue, Folder Number 25 218194 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to March 31, 2026.
